scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of exact pointwise and stratified multiplicities is supplied; exhaustive finite examples supplement but do not certify the universal quantifier. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Odd residue characteristic and finite commutative chain rings only; twofold additive convolution only. The aggregate fourth Kloosterman moment, particularly for cyclic rings, has strong historical precedent, and no independent priority audit has been performed.
title: Complete additive two-sum multiplicities of modular hyperbolas over odd finite chain rings
